canonical_title: A pull request cannot record its own merge facts: reserve them as mandatory post-merge evidence that is not a second gate, and recompute any register hash after the final edit
summary: The commit and time of the pull request that activates a governance change cannot be known before it merges. The activation record reserves them as mandatory, append-only factual evidence recorded afterward, states that this is neither a prerequisite of the decision nor a second activation event, and forbids writing them in advance. Fields that await those facts stay marked PENDING without delaying or conditioning the effect. A register hash is valid only for the final version of the file it describes: Source 18's byte count changed at each metadata stage, so the record makes the rehash a mandatory step.

claims.text: The activation record states that the merge commit and exact time exist only after the merge, that they are recorded afterward as mandatory, append-only factual evidence, that this is not a prerequisite of the decision and not a second activation event or gate, that it never changes the effective instant, and that no post-merge value may be written in advance.

evidence.locator: Section 8, second paragraph: 'The merge commit and the exact time are facts that exist only after the merge. They are recorded afterward, in Section 8.2 and in the Section 9 fields, as mandatory, append-only factual evidence.'
Section 8, second paragraph: 'It is not a prerequisite of the decision, it is not a second activation event or gate, and it never changes the effective instant.'
Section 8, second paragraph: 'no Section 8.2 value may be written in advance.'

claims.text: Until the post-merge reconciliation was complete, a field that still showed PENDING did not delay or condition the effect. The record classifies the reconciliation as audited completion evidence, not an optional step, not a pre-existing fact and not a second gate.

evidence.locator: Section 6.2, 'Facts that follow the merge': 'Until step J is complete, a field that still shows `PENDING` does not delay or condition the effect.'

claims.text: Source 18's byte count passed through 89,443, 92,433, 96,713 and 98,728 bytes before the final 100,512 as its metadata changed, so a register hash is valid only for the final blob. The record makes the recomputation and re-verification against main a mandatory step of the post-merge reconciliation.

evidence.locator: Section 6, last paragraph: 'the earlier values that Source 18 passed through as its metadata changed: 89,443, 92,433, 96,713 and 98,728 bytes.'
Section 6.1, step J: 'with Source 18's byte count and SHA-256 recomputed in Source Set row 18 and re-verified against `main`'

conditions: Applies when a status or register entry depends on a fact that only the merge of the same pull request can produce.
Requires the follow-up evidence step to be named, mandatory and audited, so that leaving it out is a visible gap and not a silent one.
Requires status wording that stays true both before and after the merge until the evidence is recorded.
anti_patterns: Writing a future merge commit, merge time or pull request number into the pull request that will produce it.
Treating the mandatory post-merge evidence as optional, or as a second gate that delays the effect.
Reusing a register hash after the file it describes was edited.
